testcase.name: huge monotonic delta and large budgets do not wrap and still respect barriers
backwards or negative monotonic time pauses without replaying previously counted time
End is terminal until an explicit seek and speed change never starts paused content
snapshot captures foreground progress but never stores running or clock state
manual seeks pause reset only their new offset and keep speed
large tick cannot jump a missing reading and leftover time is discarded
repeated play cannot restart a clock anomaly or reset running progress
speed changes materialize the old multiplier and retain fractional base progress
exact boundaries advance line wait and stage using one clock
adjacent missing readings each require explicit acknowledgement
many tiny ticks equal one large tick at fractional speed
restore rejects wrong plan version indexes and offsets instead of silently selecting text
pause captures progress and ignores all background elapsed time
speed change crossing a boundary honors the old speed and cannot pass missing content
runtime positions from other plans or illegal barriers fail explicitly
multiple texts transition without resetting elapsed time or creating a second timer
